short.en: The rewrite direction is the meaning

t.zh: 仔细看背包表：每一行只用到上一行。那何必留着整张表？只留一行，每处理一件物品，就在这一行上原地改写。
t.en: Look closely at the knapsack table: each row only uses the row above. So why keep the whole table? Keep just one row, and rewrite it in place for each item.

t.zh: 原地改写有个风险：改 dp[w] 时要读 dp[w − 重量]。如果那一格这一轮已经改过，读到的就是「已经拿过这件物品」的值。
t.en: Rewriting in place carries a risk: rewriting dp[w] reads dp[w − weight]. If that cell has already been rewritten this round, what you read is a value where the item “has already been taken”.

t.zh: 这一关有两种背包：每件最多拿一次的，和每件可以拿很多次的（比如商店里每种东西都有很多件）。电路板不难：新的 dp[w] = 取较大（旧的 dp[w]，dp[w − 重量] + 价值）。视野里的红框 dp[w] 是写入新值的地方，在视野里点它，读到的是改写前的旧值；dp[w − 重量] 由伸缩臂够到。
t.en: This level has two kinds of backpack: one where each item can be taken at most once, and one where each item can be taken many times (like a shop with plenty of everything). The board isn’t hard: new dp[w] = max(old dp[w], dp[w − weight] + value). The red frame dp[w] in the view is where the new value is written, and clicking it in the view reads the old value before it is rewritten; dp[w − weight] is what the telescopic arm reaches.

t.zh: 真正的门道在机器的：每件最多拿一次时，它从右往左改写；每件可以拿很多次时，它从左往右改写。同一块电路板，为什么换个方向，答案就不一样？
t.en: The real trick is the machine’s : when each item can be taken at most once, it rewrites right to left; when each item can be taken many times, it rewrites left to right. Why does the same circuit board give different answers when only the direction changes?

goal.zh: 一种背包每件最多拿一次，另一种每件可以拿很多次，总重量都不能超过容量。拼好电路，让四个测试都算对。
goal.en: In one kind of backpack each item can be taken at most once; in the other, many times. Either way, the total weight can’t exceed the capacity. Build the circuit so that all four tests come out right.

how.zh: 黄色是正在改写的格子；红色表示读到了这一轮刚改过的值。
how.en: Yellow is the cell being rewritten; red means a value rewritten earlier this round was read.

say.zh: 电路板：新的 dp[w] = 取较大（旧的 dp[w]，dp[w − 重量] + 价值）。三样都要读进来：旧的 dp[w]、dp[w − 重量] 和物品价值。
say.en: The circuit board: new dp[w] = max(old dp[w], dp[w − weight] + value). All three need reading in: the old dp[w], dp[w − weight] and the item value.

body.zh: 从右往左改写时，dp[w − 重量] 还没被这件物品改过，读到的是旧值，所以每件最多拿一次。
body.en: Rewriting from right to left, dp[w − weight] hasn’t been touched by this item yet, so it reads an old value: each item at most once.

body.zh: 从左往右改写时，dp[w − 重量] 可能已经拿过这件物品，再拿一次正好，所以每件可以拿很多次。
body.en: Rewriting from left to right, dp[w − weight] may already include this item, and taking it again is just right: each item as many times as you like.

body.zh: 同一块电路板，只是方向不同，解决的就是两个不同的问题。这种只留一行的写法叫滚动数组，能把几千行的表压成一行。
body.en: The same circuit board, just a different direction, solves two different problems. Keeping only one row like this is called a rolling array, and it can squash a table thousands of rows tall into a single row.

note.zh: 一行原地改写：从右往左，每件一次；从左往右，每件无限次。
note.en: One row rewritten in place: right to left, once each; left to right, unlimited.
